name: buyer-indecision
description: Overcome buyer indecision with the JOLT Effect — Judge indecision, Offer recommendation, Limit exploration, Take risk off the table. For deals stuck on "need to think about it", FOMU (fear of messing up), and no-decision losses. Matthew Dixon & Ted McKenna. Use in late-stage enterprise deals, deal reviews, and proposal follow-up. Triggers on: "buyer indecision", "JOLT", "need to think about it", "no decision", "stuck deal", "FOMU", "fear of failure buyer", "close the gap intent to action".
